quests.quest_title: Does the sidewalk stop or have a missing section?
quests.quest_description: Check only the sidewalk section highlighted on the map. A broken slab is a surface problem, not a missing sidewalk.

quests.quest_title: If there is a gap, where would someone have to travel?
quests.quest_description: Select what you can see. Do not walk into traffic to investigate.

quests.quest_title: What is the narrowest clear walking width (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: Find the tightest spot along this mapped sidewalk. If safe, open your phone's Measure app and measure the open space between obstacles, not the full concrete width. Enter inches; leave blank if you cannot measure. Phone measurements are approximate.

quests.quest_title: Is the sidewalk completely blocked?
quests.quest_description: Can a person continue on this sidewalk without leaving it? Record a blockage only when there is no visible path through. Do not enter the road to check.

quests.quest_title: What problems do you see on the sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Select all visible issues. Only record what you can observe today; take a photo of problems. Do not guess whether a surface is ADA compliant.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: Uneven surface or abrupt height change

quests.quest_title: What is in the walking path?
quests.quest_description: Choose everything that reduces the clear walking space. Only select what you can see now.

quests.quest_title: What is the sidewalk made of?
quests.quest_description: Choose the main surface material.

quests.quest_title: What separates the sidewalk from moving vehicles?
quests.quest_description: Choose everything between this sidewalk and moving traffic. A painted line alone is not a physical barrier.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: Nothing; sidewalk is next to traffic

quests.quest_title: How many driveways cross this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Count driveways along only this highlighted section. Do not count intersections.

quests.quest_title: Do driveways create a visible bump or dip across the walking path?
quests.quest_description: Look for abrupt changes where vehicles cross the sidewalk.

quests.quest_title: Does the sidewalk visibly tilt sideways or become unusually steep?
quests.quest_description: Only flag obvious locations; do not estimate slope percentages or use a phone level. If yes, photograph the location from a safe position.

quests.quest_title: Photograph this sidewalk
quests.quest_description: Take a photo showing the path and any missing section, narrow point, visible slope, or obstacle. Avoid photographing people or vehicle plates when possible.

quests.quest_title: Optional: scan this sidewalk with phone LiDAR
quests.quest_description: Only if your phone supports LiDAR and the app offers scanning. Stand in a safe place. This optional scan is supplemental; do not treat automatically estimated slopes as verified ADA measurements.

quests.quest_title: How many vehicle lanes does this half-crossing pass through?
quests.quest_description: IMPORTANT: this mapped crossing is only ONE PART of a full street crossing: from a curb to a median/lane separator, or from that separator to the opposite curb. Count only vehicle lanes crossed in this highlighted part, including turn lanes. Observe from the sidewalk; never enter traffic to count.

quests.quest_title: Is there a marked crosswalk on this part?
quests.quest_description: Look for painted lines or stripes across the lanes in this highlighted half-crossing.

quests.quest_title: What do the crosswalk markings look like?
quests.quest_description: Choose the closest pattern.

quests.quest_title: Are the crosswalk markings worn or missing in places?
quests.quest_description: Only assess visible paint, not whether crossing feels safe.

quests.quest_title: What tells drivers or pedestrians when to stop or cross?
quests.quest_description: Choose the main traffic control visible for this half-crossing.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: No light, beacon or stop/yield sign

quests.quest_title: What pedestrian signal features can you see?
quests.quest_description: Choose all that are present on this half-crossing. If there is no pedestrian signal, choose that only. Do not press a button unless you are safely positioned.

quests.quest_title: Is there a median or refuge island at the end of this half-crossing?
quests.quest_description: A median is a divider between directions of traffic; a refuge island provides a place to pause. Record only the end of the highlighted half-crossing.

quests.quest_title: Which vehicles could cross your path during this half-crossing?
quests.quest_description: Imagine walking ONLY from the highlighted starting curb to the median/lane divider, or from the divider to the next curb. Select every vehicle movement that could enter this portion while a pedestrian is crossing. You are identifying possible conflicts, not estimating risk. Watch safely from the curb; do not test any movement.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: Vehicles turning left without a separate protected green arrow
Vehicles turning right while pedestrians may cross
Bus pulling away from a stop across this path
Vehicle entering or leaving a driveway
Bicycles or scooters crossing the pedestrian path
Through traffic without a traffic signal or stop sign

quests.quest_title: Are there warning signs for drivers approaching this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Look for pedestrian crossing signs facing approaching drivers.

quests.quest_title: Is there a bike lane crossing the walking path?
quests.quest_description: Include a separated bike lane or painted bike lane intersecting this half-crossing.

quests.quest_title: Is the sidewalk corner extended into the roadway?
quests.quest_description: A curb extension makes the corner stick out past the normal curb line and can shorten the crossing.

quests.quest_title: Optional: is there something else that concerns you about crossing here?
quests.quest_description: This is your own observation, not a safety score. Choose the main concern if you have one.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: Drivers do not appear to yield

quests.quest_title: Photograph this half-crossing
quests.quest_description: From a safe location, photograph the highlighted portion, including lane markings, signs, and any median. Never stand in the roadway to take a picture.

quests.quest_title: Is the mapped bus stop actually here?
quests.quest_description: Check for a bus stop sign, pole or other clear stop marker. If no, the remaining questions can be skipped.

quests.quest_title: How is the bus stop marked?
quests.quest_description: Choose the most obvious marker.

quests.quest_title: Is there a clear area where someone can board the bus?
quests.quest_description: Look for a level-looking area next to the bus stopping location, free of obstacles. Do not judge actual slope.

quests.quest_title: What is the clear boarding area width (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, use your phone's Measure app across the open area beside the curb, excluding benches or poles. Approximate only; leave blank if it cannot be measured.

quests.quest_title: What is the clear boarding area length along the curb (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, open your phone's Measure app and measure the clear length parallel to the curb. Approximate only; leave blank if unsafe or unclear.

quests.quest_title: Is there a continuous path from the sidewalk to the boarding area?
quests.quest_description: Check whether someone can reach the boarding area without walking in a vehicle lane.

quests.quest_title: What is the narrowest clear width on that path (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, use your phone's Measure app at the narrowest place between the sidewalk and boarding area. Leave blank if you cannot measure.

quests.quest_title: What blocks or damages the boarding area or access path?
quests.quest_description: Select everything visible.

quests.quest_title: Is there a bus shelter?
quests.quest_description: Look for a roofed waiting structure.

quests.quest_title: Is there seating?
quests.quest_description: Look for a bench or built-in seat at the stop.

quests.quest_title: Is there a marked crossing within about one block?
quests.quest_description: Look from a safe position; do not walk into the roadway to investigate.

quests.quest_title: Photograph the bus stop and boarding area
quests.quest_description: Try to show the stop marker, clear boarding space and path to the sidewalk.

quests.quest_title: Are there traffic lights at this intersection?
quests.quest_description: Look for traffic signals that direct vehicles. Crossing details belong to the separate mapped half-crossing quests.

quests.quest_title: What posted speed limit can you see (mph)?
quests.quest_description: Read a nearby speed-limit sign only if safely visible. Leave blank if there is no sign you can read. Do not estimate actual vehicle speeds.

quests.quest_title: Which turning lanes can you see?
quests.quest_description: Choose lanes that are marked or clearly dedicated to turning. Observe from the sidewalk.

quests.quest_title: Are there streetlights near the intersection?
quests.quest_description: Record visible installed lights, not a judgment about whether lighting is adequate.

quests.quest_title: Photograph the intersection
quests.quest_description: From the sidewalk, capture the intersection layout and visible signs or signals.

quests.quest_title: What kind of curb or street entry is here?
quests.quest_description: Check the mapped point where a person leaves the sidewalk to cross. A curb ramp slopes down to street level; a blended transition has little or no distinct ramp.

quests.quest_title: Does this ramp point toward the marked crossing?
quests.quest_description: Only answer if a curb ramp exists. Look at where the ramp leads, not whether it meets ADA rules.

quests.quest_title: How wide is the ramp's clear path (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, open your phone's Measure app and measure across the usable ramp, excluding raised edges and obstacles. Leave blank if you cannot measure.

quests.quest_title: How long is the sloped part of the ramp (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, open your phone's Measure app. Measure along the ground from the top of the sloped ramp to where it meets the street. Do not measure or estimate slope angle. Leave blank if unsafe.

quests.quest_title: How wide is the clear flat-looking area at the top (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, use the phone's Measure app across the open area at the top. A photo and approximate dimension do not establish that it is level. Leave blank if it cannot be measured.

quests.quest_title: How deep is that clear area from front to back (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, use the phone's Measure app from the back of the ramp toward the sidewalk. Do not use a phone level. Leave blank if it cannot be measured.

quests.quest_title: Are there raised edges or protective sides beside the ramp?
quests.quest_description: Look for raised sides that may help keep wheels from leaving the ramp.

quests.quest_title: Are there bumpy warning tiles at the street edge?
quests.quest_description: Look for a strip of raised, truncated bumps where the sidewalk or ramp meets the road.

quests.quest_title: How deep is the bumpy warning strip (in inches)?
quests.quest_description: If safe, use the phone's Measure app from the front to the back of the bumpy strip, in the direction of travel. Leave blank if unsafe.

quests.quest_title: Is the curb entry damaged or blocked?
quests.quest_description: Look for cracks, bumps, poles, plants, or other obstacles.

quests.quest_title: Photograph this curb entry
quests.quest_description: Take a photo showing the ramp or missing ramp, landing, warning tiles and road connection.
